title: Approximate every feasible boundary or affine-degenerate mean with positive rational activities
statement: For Gamma of a fixed weakly reversible structure, A(theta)=log sum_(x inGamma)exp(theta.x)/x! is finite and smooth everywhere, bounded above by sum_i exp(theta_i); grad A=E X and Hess A=Cov X. For m-prime in relative interior conv(Gamma), choose finite F whose convex hull contains a relative neighborhood of m-prime. On the linear space parallel to aff(Gamma), G=A-theta.m-prime >=r||theta||-max_(x inF)log(x!), so it is coercive and attains a minimizer. Projected gradient0 implies E X=m-prime since both lie in the same affine hull. Approximate any m in CLOSED conv(Gamma) by such interior targets, then approximate finite positive real activities by positive rationals using mean continuity. This proves existence for every epsilon>0, including singleton/zero/boundary targets, without an interior margin or conservation. It supplies NO polynomial rational-height or parameter-selection bound.
